description: Real names where the merged roads meet: a Korean name by its romanization and name_sounds (Ji-eun: Gi-ưn said /ən/, Hyun Woo: level tones), an automatic Japanese name one phonetic word per syllable (Heizaemon), a shouted name (YUKI), a Western roster name spelled like a Vietnamese syllable (Dan: /ɗ/ by the book's rulings), Vietnamese words sea-g2p only reads in English (pin, veo, boa), the letter K (ca) and the English word APP. One roster, three books (origin ja / ko / none): `sharedWords` is what Studio writes for the roster, `proven` what the book proves by itself; readings = proven < sharedWords.readings. `said` and `phonemes` are the same on the desktop, in Studio and on the phone; `tag` is the reading tag of the clip key.
